# Vendored tree-sitter-yaml

`src/`, `bindings/swift/`, `queries/` and `LICENSE` are copied from upstream, unmodified.
**Do not edit them by hand.** Refresh with `macapp/Scripts/vendor-tree-sitter-grammars.sh`.
`Package.swift` is ours: upstream's probes for `src/scanner.c`, which SwiftPM gets wrong.
